requirements_source: User search brief (15 percent distortion and 50 mm frame margin)
report_version_limit: This branch copy of docs/beds-report.md ends at round 5; rounds 6 and 7 are not present. The user-supplied 50 mm condition is applied as a search requirement, without claiming it already exists in production checks.
acceptance_checks: Measure actual separate mattress geometry, source units and head/foot orientation; never use frame bounds as mattress bounds.
Compute width and length multipliers from actual mattress dimensions. Both must be between 0.5 and 2.0; the larger divided by the smaller, minus one, must be at most 0.15 (15 percent).
Measure every retained frame edge against the transformed mattress: at most 0.050 m (50 mm) outward beyond each mattress edge; retain ladder in frame/route review.
Keep one transform for the whole bed; both bunk mattresses must match 0.900 by 2.000 m and their tops must remain 0.400 and 1.400 m above finished floor. Kids B top remains 0.475 m.

Verify bed-only separability, support, guard and ladder geometry, collisions, doors, routes, storage fronts, cloth and unchanged-room neutral preview. No material retouching or room changes to rescue a mismatch.

screened_out.name: Bed Sweet
screened_out.reason: Published sleeping place 1500 by 2000 (units implicit, interpreted as mm). If confirmed, Kids B factors are 0.8 and 1.0, giving 25 percent distortion; published side thickness 120 also conflicts with a 50 mm frame margin. Not shortlisted.

screened_out.name: bed with headboard begie 120 * 190
screened_out.reason: Title supplies 120 by 190 without units or a mattress definition; preview shows only a rounded panel/headboard, not an identifiable whole bed. If it meant a 1.20 by 1.90 m mattress, factors 1 and 1.052632 give 5.2632 percent distortion, but this cannot establish a bed-only oak candidate.

screened_out.name: Children's Bunk Bed Lucia
screened_out.reason: Published overall dimensions 0.839 by 1.717 by 2.526 m, axes unnamed. Large storage staircase shown; no ladder and no mattress sizes. Poor prospect for retained-frame margin.

screened_out.name: Bunk Bed
screened_out.reason: Listing preview carries assorted loose toys/props and stylized bedding; no dimensions. Prefer cleaner bed-only prospects.

screened_out.name: Single wooden bed
screened_out.reason: Author explicitly describes separable mattress/bedding, but distressed horror-game appearance and unspecified single-bed size are weak prospects for a light-oak 1.20 m small double.

screened_out.reason: Overall 1.99 by 1.03 by 1.59 m, not mattress dimensions. Metal flat-colour reserve superseded by the dimensioned wood bunk; no additional download priority.

recommendation: Measure Em3D bunk first if the lead authorizes a download; screen Nordi dimensions first. Retain procedural beds. No evidence supports a promised round-5/6 pass.
